title: OCI Kubernetes Engine (OKE) GPU Host Repair enables Kubernetes to direct GPU host recovery
excerpt: We are announcing OCI Kubernetes Engine (OKE) GPU Host Repair, a feature that both makes faults discoverable and coordinates repairs directly through the Kubernetes API. OKE surfaces host health and maintenance information through Kubernetes, prepares affected nodes for repair, coordinates the applicable Compute action, and restores capacity.
